svg.text: Job Monitor Agent on SAP BTP
A CAP application that pulls scheduled job runs from SAP Cloud ALM into SAP HANA Cloud, shows failures in a dashboard,
explains them with an AI agent and warns job schedulers by e-mail. Users and agents only read the persisted data.
machine OAuth client with scope A2AClient
Subaccount sap-genai | Cloud Foundry eu20, space GenAI
Failed job monitor: KPIs, failed jobs, detail
XSUAA login, JWT forwarded to CAP
Users get access only through role collections
OData V4 /odata/v4/job-monitor (summary, jobErrors, analyzeJob) - scope User
A2A server POST /a2a + public agent card - scope A2AClient, read-only
Pull job runs and logs from Cloud ALM (watermark + overlap)
Parse, classify status (Success / Error / Warning / In Process)
Upsert duplicate-safe runs and events in one transaction
Warn schedulers: one grouped e-mail per scheduler, no repeats
Single data source for dashboard and A2A
SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub
Failure explanation: max two likely causes
One digest e-mail per job scheduler
The user opens the approuter URL and signs in through XSUAA.
The approuter forwards the JWT; CAP requires scope User.
CAP reads persisted job runs from HANA, never from Cloud ALM.
Analyze job sends the failed run to the AI agent via its destination.
Access: add the user to role collection JobFailureMonitor_Viewer or _Admin.
Every 60 s CAP calls the Cloud ALM APIs via CLOUD_ALM_API.
Runs and events are parsed and upserted into HANA with a watermark.
Job Scheduling calls POST /run (JobRunner); failures are grouped
per scheduler and sent once through Microsoft Graph.
Cloud ALM credentials stay in the Destination service; the app never stores them.
